description: Hand-labeled retrieval evaluation for the sample lease. 'evidence' lists phrases from the lease that a retrieved chunk must contain; matching ignores case, whitespace and punctuation. Questions with answerable=false have no evidence and are used only to inspect score behavior. 'tags' describe the failure mode a question probes: fact, paraphrase, vocab-gap (question wording differs from the clause), multi-clause (several facts needed), cross-chunk, continuation (clause continues across a page break), calculation, distractor (a similar-but-wrong clause exists), unanswerable. Questions q11-q35 were drafted from the lease text and should be reviewed by a human. 'answer_facts' (answerable questions only) is a list of fact groups for the answer-level eval: each group lists acceptable phrasings (any-of, whole-word, case-insensitive); fact recall is the share of groups an answer contains. 'answer_must_not' (optional) lists phrasings that state the opposite of the correct answer; if one appears the answer is scored as contradicted (fact recall 0). 'label_note' records label changes and why.
